purpose: Validate that the unified property fixture governance manifest references the required controls, source files, validation layers and publication gates without silently upgrading legal or publication status.

checks.name: Governance chain completeness
checks.requirement: All fixture governance layers from registry through closure are represented.

checks.name: Required controls
checks.requirement: Identity, lifecycle, provenance, dependencies, impact, revalidation, privacy, proposition scope and closure controls are represented.

checks.name: Source references
checks.requirement: Manifest references the established fixture governance files.

checks.name: Historical protection
checks.requirement: Manifest preserves the rule that historical validation results remain immutable.

checks.name: Publication separation
checks.requirement: Manifest does not mark the pathway publication-ready merely because technical governance exists.

checks.name: Legal-source separation
checks.requirement: Technical fixture governance remains separate from substantive legal verification.

checks.name: Synthetic evidence boundary
checks.requirement: Synthetic fixtures cannot establish real-world property facts.

guardrails: It does not verify Irish property law.
It does not represent live official-record retrieval.
It does not make any property pathway publication-ready.
